description: Prices one mirror exactly as the shop does: product gross price with its option lines, weight, delivery methods with rate-table prices (add postalCode for a delivery estimate), the cheapest total, the delivery window and whether it can be ordered. An estimate: the binding price is shown at checkout on lustrix.eu. Only include paid options the customer asked for.

backlitLed.description: LED behind the mirror lighting the wall (paid; only when asked)

bevelWidthMm.description: Bevel width in mm (5-30); required with edge=bevel

country.description: Delivery country. PL with locale pl; DE or AT with locale de. Default: the shop home country.

frame.description: Paid option: a slim matte black aluminium frame (rectangle/square mirrors only). Set ONLY when the customer explicitly asked for a frame; omit otherwise (frameless is the default). Check list_options.frame.available first. With a frame, widthCm × heightCm is the outer frame size, the edge is a hidden technical grind (edge: grind; no bevel), and holes, LED, heating mat, switch and tempering are not available.

frontlitLed.description: LED shining through a sanded stripe on the mirror face (paid; only when asked). Patterns per shape: list_options

heatingMat.description: Anti-fog heating mat (paid; only when asked)

height2Cm.description: Height of the second vertical side in cm, trapezoid shapes only

heightCm.description: Height in cm (not for a circle; a square may omit it)

xCm.description: Hole centre, cm from the left edge of the bounding box

yCm.description: Hole centre, cm from the top edge of the bounding box

locale.description: Language of every text in the answer: pl (Polish shop, PLN) or de (German shop for DE/AT, EUR). Default pl.

postalCode.description: Delivery postal code (PL 00-000, DE 12345, AT 1234). Only used to estimate delivery; never stored.

safetyFilm.description: Paid option: a safety backing film on the back of the mirror (if the mirror breaks, most fragments stay on the film; it does not make the mirror unbreakable), priced per m² of the mirror; mirrors only. Set ONLY when the customer explicitly asked for it; omit otherwise. Check list_options.safetyFilm.available first, and its note for whether it is available with a frame or with the heating mat.

switchType.description: Switch, only together with an LED (paid)

tempered.description: Tempered safety glass (paid; only when the customer asks)

widthCm.description: Width in cm; for a circle the diameter

name: quote_mirror
title: Price a mirror made to measure
